title: Bae U Barbie Invites Aliko Dangote for Interview, Billionaire Accepts Podcast Offer
excerpt: Nigerian comedian and content creator Bae U Barbie has secured a major response from billionaire Aliko Dangote after inviting him to appear on his popular YouTube show, Curiosity Made Me Ask. Dangote agreed to join the programme and share his business journey with younger Nigerians.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
Nigerian content creator Adebayo Ridwan, popularly known as Bae U Barbie or Isbae U, has invited billionaire businessman Aliko Dangote to appear on his YouTube interview programme, Curiosity Made Me Ask.

The invitation came during Bae U’s visit to Dangote Refinery in Lagos on Monday, October 19, 2026. Their conversation has attracted attention online after Dangote agreed to appear on the show.

Bae U explained that many of Dangote’s previous interviews had taken place on platforms that younger Nigerians do not typically watch. According to the comedian, his generation is interested in learning about the billionaire’s business journey and understanding opportunities connected to his company.

He also pointed to the interest among young Nigerians in investing in Dangote’s businesses, including the proposed initial public offering (IPO).

“Most of the interviews we’ve seen you have been on platforms that my generation don’t watch,” Bae U told the billionaire.

## What Bae U Told Dangote

During the exchange, Bae U clarified that he was not asking Dangote to dismiss his media team. Instead, he wanted the businessman to consider speaking directly to younger audiences through a platform they regularly watch.

He then asked when Dangote would be available to appear on Curiosity Made Me Ask, describing it as an opportunity to bring the man behind one of Africa’s biggest industrial businesses to a wider YouTube audience.

The request was particularly notable because Bae U’s programme is known for its unusual interview format, humorous questions and candid conversations with prominent personalities.

The comedian has previously interviewed influential Nigerians, including former President Olusegun Obasanjo, making Dangote a potentially significant addition to the programme.

## Aliko Dangote Accepts the Invitation

Responding to Bae U, Dangote acknowledged the importance of connecting with young Nigerians and sharing experiences with the next generation.

The billionaire agreed that younger audiences deserved greater attention and said established business leaders should be willing to engage with them.

He also expressed concern that many young Nigerians know little about important events and personalities from the country’s past, highlighting the importance of conversations between generations.

Dangote subsequently accepted the invitation, assuring Bae U that he would appear on the show.

“We will come,” he said.

However, the businessman did not announce a specific date for the interview.

## Dangote Wants an Open Conversation With Young Nigerians

Dangote’s response suggested that he was interested in more than simply making a guest appearance. He indicated that he wanted the conversation to give people an opportunity to ask questions about his life, business decisions and journey to success.

He emphasised that sharing personal experiences could help younger Nigerians understand how he built his businesses and developed into one of Africa’s most prominent industrialists.

The billionaire also spoke about the importance of humility and simplicity, explaining that his current wealth and status had not changed his willingness to relate with ordinary people.

His comments have added to the interest surrounding the proposed interview, particularly among young Nigerians who want to learn about entrepreneurship, investments and wealth creation.

## Why the Interview Could Be Important

An appearance by Dangote on Curiosity Made Me Ask could provide a different kind of conversation from the traditional business interviews he has participated in.

Bae U’s show attracts viewers through its informal style, direct questions and entertainment-driven approach. That format could allow younger audiences to hear Dangote discuss topics ranging from his early business experiences to the challenges of building large companies.

The conversation could also generate questions about industrial development in Nigeria, job creation, entrepreneurship and opportunities for young people.

For Bae U, securing the billionaire’s agreement represents a potentially significant moment for his programme. For Dangote, it offers an opportunity to engage an audience that consumes much of its entertainment and information through digital platforms.

## Social Media Users Await the Interview

News of Dangote’s acceptance has generated interest among Nigerians eager to see how the billionaire will respond to Bae U’s distinctive interview style.

Although the date has not been confirmed, the prospect of the industrialist appearing on a show known for its unpredictable questions has made the proposed episode a talking point.

Viewers will likely be interested in whether Bae U asks about Dangote’s rise to wealth, his business empire, his experiences as an entrepreneur and the advice he would give young Nigerians hoping to achieve similar success.

Until an official recording or release date is announced, audiences will have to wait to see when the highly anticipated conversation will take place.

## Conclusion

Bae U Barbie’s invitation to Aliko Dangote has resulted in a positive response from one of Nigeria’s most prominent businessmen.

By asking Dangote to appear on Curiosity Made Me Ask, the content creator highlighted the growing importance of digital platforms in connecting influential figures with younger audiences.

Dangote’s acceptance has raised expectations for a conversation that could combine entertainment with lessons about business, leadership and personal success.

While the interview date remains unknown, the billionaire’s willingness to participate has already created excitement around the possibility of seeing him in a different and more informal setting.
